name: Karl Fischer Moisture
purpose: Measure powder moisture content as a repeat-level observation in ppm.
interpretation_notes: Higher moisture can indicate storage drift or conditioning response.
Always compare alongside powder state and storage history.

name: Particle Size Distribution
purpose: Capture D10, D50 and D90 from vendor text exports, treating rows as repeats.
interpretation_notes: Span is calculated when D10, D50 and D90 are available for the same repeat.
PSD shifts are most useful when compared to alloy, batch and conditioning state.

name: GranuTap Density
purpose: Measure bulk density and tapped density, then calculate Hausner ratio and Carr index.
interpretation_notes: Hausner ratio and Carr index are calculated per repeat before summary statistics.
Repeat count may be 1, 2, 3 or more depending on available material.

name: SEM Image Metadata
purpose: Attach image paths and microscopy metadata to a powder passport.
interpretation_notes: Image count and metadata help explain morphology context.
Manual comments remain important until automated feature extraction is added.

name: GranuDrum / GranuFlow
purpose: Preserve avalanche, hysteresis, reverse and speed sequence traces for future flow comparison.
interpretation_notes: Repeats may be optional for early uploads.

name: FT4 Powder Rheology
purpose: Store raw files and CSV summaries for future rheology passports.
interpretation_notes: Raw .prb files may be binary, so CSV summaries are acceptable.
Interpretation should stay attached to sample state.

name: ASEM / AZtecFeature
purpose: Store particle-level morphology and chemistry for future comparison to PSD.
interpretation_notes: ECD distributions can be compared to laser PSD.
Chemistry annotations should preserve particle-level records.

name: XRD Phase Notes
purpose: Record phase names, fractions, peak positions, FWHM and comments.
interpretation_notes: Phase notes become more useful when compared to conditioning and thermal history.
Manual uploads are acceptable for the first version.
